description: This file defines a React hook called useInput that manages user input for a game or interactive component. It handles keyboard events (arrow keys and space for jump) and touch events for mobile devices, providing an API to attach touch zones.

methods.name: useInput({ jumpCooldownMs = 220 } = {})
methods.description: Main hook function that manages input states and provides methods to handle keyboard and touch interactions for game controls.

methods.name: attachTouchZones
methods.description: Creates and returns functions to attach touch event listeners to specified DOM elements, enabling touch controls.

methods.name: consumeJump
methods.description: Returns true once when a jump has been requested, then resets the jump request flag.
